decisions.reason: The NFT becoming locatable in Rabby is already represented as runtime evidence; requiring its image and information to render is a separate media-rendering behavior and does not change the discovery requirement.
The source requires wallet presentation of NFT media and information but does not change the required metadata fields, counters, badges, or referral-code content.
Wallet media rendering does not alter which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state follows an NFT transfer.
The source does not change the Base network deployment requirement.
NFT image and information rendering in a wallet does not affect royalty amount, enforcement standard, creator controls, or marketplace policy.
Although the visible NFT resulted from an earlier USDC mint, the source changes only post-mint wallet media presentation and does not alter the USDC mint flow.
The statement that the client will next try an ETH purchase is a test intention, not a change to the ETH wallet mint requirement.
Wallet NFT media visibility does not change referral eligibility or self-referral validation.
The source concerns an NFT displayed in a wallet, not the separate book-cover presentation on the landing page.
The source does not change Transak provider selection, payment methods, wallet provisioning, mint destination, or the deferred fiat-mint lifecycle.
Wallet NFT media rendering does not affect email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
The missing wallet image and information do not entail any change to the curated badge set, badge icons, set size, or dashboard layout.
